payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: Increasing compact_transformer depth from 6 to 8 (with hidden=256, patch_size=4, 49 tokens) will improve validation accuracy beyond 0.9917 by providing additional hierarchical abstraction layers. In histopathology, distinguishing confusable classes (smooth muscle vs stroma, normal mucosa vs adenocarcinoma, background vs debris) requires progressive feature refinement: low-level texture → mid-level nuclear/cellular morphology → high-level tissue architecture. Eight transformer blocks provide more sequential refinement than six, while the 49-token sequence (7x7 grid) remains short enough to avoid overfitting on ~90k samples. Slightly higher dropout (0.2 vs 0.15) compensates for the increased model capacity. The model was still improving at epoch 30 in t0004, so 40 epochs with patience 8 gives adequate convergence time.
